name: r033.phase4_semantic_autonomous_sound_return_drive500_age_reentry_rev1_mcw
description: R-033 changed-premise successor. It reuses only the zero-credit supply-empty five-member footing and delayed acoustic source from the successful drive-500 route, requires a real production-state falsification before input, and declares a native save/reload continuation after any returned sound report.

steps.label: audit_idle_starvation_drive_footing
steps.abort_reason: the fresh route lacks the idle five-member, zero-supply production footing

steps.label: audit_delayed_zero_credit_explosion_source
steps.abort_reason: the isolated delayed source is missing, outside its loaded-map cap, or contaminated by a field channel

steps.label: operate_r033_drive500_sound_return_age_reentry
steps.objective: Before any action, inspect the fresh production scheduler dispatch facts and stop unless its drive is at least 500; this falsifies the retained drive-358 control without changing any threshold. Then use only observed native waits to establish the ordinary dispatch, local watch before source emission, source callback, and physical return. Once the source-matched returned report is visible, preserve its original sound class/key/OMT/observation minute, perform only the declared native save-and-quit chain, and use the replacement process to compare the retained provenance and age.
proof_targets: native production drive at least 500 with zero supplies before input
idle roster and no active owner
reloaded report provenance and nondecreasing age
invariants: the source cannot count before native watch arrival
do not inject a signal, lead, report, operation, route, owner, or member

steps.label: save_returned_sound_age_boundary
steps.objective: After a source-matched returned report has been observed, use only the currently advertised native save-and-quit action and confirmation. This boundary is not success unless the reentry process preserves the report provenance and original observation time.

steps.label: confirm_returned_sound_age_process_exit
steps.objective: From the native main-menu owner, accept only the advertised quit action and confirmation, allowing the declared continuation to bind a replacement process.

steps.label: bind_r033_drive500_returned_sound_reentry
steps.objective: Bind the replacement process to the saved world before comparing the returned sound report.
invariants: no fixture reinstall, clone, or source/report mutation

steps.label: audit_returned_sound_report_after_reentry
steps.abort_reason: the replacement process did not preserve the returned sound report's native provenance

proof_gates.label: R-033 changed-premise sound return/reentry route is bound to one declared native continuation
R-033 returned sound survives native process replacement

evidence_contract.claim: one source-bound semantic-only run may establish the changed production premise, native sound-to-returned-report route, and native save/reload preservation of original sound provenance/age
evidence_contract.failure_rule: any initial drive below 500, premature/absent source, missing callback/report, save/reentry failure, provenance drift, or injected state leaves the route unproved
